title: Mary Says Yes
reflectionQuestion: What do you think Mary felt when the angel told her she would be the mother of Jesus?
kidSafetyNotes: Gentle wonder. Angel's greeting + 'nothing is impossible with God' + Mary's trusting 'yes' (her real words softened: 'let it happen just as you have said'). Grounding: an ordinary little room + her chores, the plain walls lit up by the angel (child-can-see-it pass). Voice Mary Ponder (Luke 2:19 nod). Threads to 1821 -- the same Mary who says yes to the baby stands by him at the cross.
